rationale: GO: the live Richards (Wake) homepage exposes a real, reproducible, server-rendered navigation with an explicit 'Masculino' section containing 15 real category hrefs (14 sub-categories + 1 Outlet link), independently reproducible via a plain HTTP GET (no authentication, no browser needed). Every one of the 15 enumerated paths returned a real GraphQL hotsite(url:) response with first:1 has_products=true (a genuine product sample was returned for each). Two control probes (a fabricated nonexistent path -> hotsite:null, and the real feminino/vestidos hotsite -> has_products) prove the probe mechanism is discriminating and not defaulting to a permissive true. Per D-05, this fixture supersedes the stale brand.mappings entries persisted in backend/data/brands.json for richards (which used incorrect paths missing the '/masculino' prefix, e.g. '/camisas' instead of the real '/masculino/camisas', and a wrong slug 'tricot' instead of the real 'tricots-e-blusas') -- those stale mappings are NOT used as the discovery source in WakeEngine.discover_categories()/get_catalog() after this plan.
